scope: Complete local demo seed only; no live Supabase records read or written.
policy: Only actual photographs discovered through web searches and individually opened/viewed before mapping are included.
Covers are at least 1200px wide and approximately 2:1 (accepted range 1.8–2.2); Seoul retains its native 1280x595 composition. All other covers are 2:1.
Product sources and final square files are at least 600px in both dimensions. No upscaling or generated imagery.
sourceDimensions describes downloaded image bytes used for the crop; originalDimensions is full original metadata where applicable. imageUrl/downloadUrl are exact observed URLs.
Photo reuse is allowed only for identical named product occurrences. Destination covers may repeat for the same destination or a location within a specified country.
Attribution, license and changes are retained per asset. Commercial product photography has no asserted open reuse license.

Representative real photographs within the same named brand/product family are allowed. Exact pictured variants are recorded in assets without adding shade, model, size, flavor, edition or contents claims to seed labels. Unconfirmable bundles remain empty. All mapped product photographs are visually checked watermark-free; no watermark removal is used.
